extracted.intended_audience: USPTO patent examiners and patent practitioners (applicants, patent attorneys/agents)
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural and substantive rules governing examination of patent applications at the USPTO, covering authority, required filings, search and information duties, claim rejections, amendments, replies, abandonment, interviews, affidavits/declarations, and file maintenance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statutory authority for examination (§701)
rubrics_metrics.description: Establishes the statutory authority under which patent examination is conducted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application requisites (§702)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements that an application must meet to be considered proper for examination (application requisites).

rubrics_metrics.name: Search and information requirements (§704)
rubrics_metrics.description: Obligations concerning prior art search and provision of information during examination (search and information requirements).

rubrics_metrics.name: Patentability reports (§705)
rubrics_metrics.description: Preparation and content of patentability reports to document examination findings concerning patentability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Claim rejection procedures (§706) — general
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for issuing claim rejections during examination, including grounds and handling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prior art rejections (§706)
rubrics_metrics.description: Rejections based on prior art (e.g., novelty, obviousness) and related procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Non-prior-art rejections (§706)
rubrics_metrics.description: Rejections based on statutory or formal defects other than prior art (e.g., §101, §112 issues).

rubrics_metrics.name: Previously allowed claims and rejection after allowance (§706)
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules governing treatment of claims that were previously allowed and circumstances under which they may be rejected after allowance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Final rejections with timing requirements (§706)
rubrics_metrics.description: When a final rejection is proper, including timing requirements for taking final action.

rubrics_metrics.name: Final Rejection Practice (§706.07)
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on final rejection practice including when a final rejection is appropriate on a second action, circumstances for first-action final rejections, Transitional After-Final Practice, and Request for Continued Examination (RCE) practice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes specific subrules on second-action finals, first-action finals, transitional after-final practice, and RCE procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examiner's letters and citations (§707)
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for examiner correspondence and citation of references in the file during examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendment procedures (§714) — responsiveness
rubrics_metrics.description: Amendments submitted in reply to office actions must be 'fully responsive' to the office action.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Amendments not fully responsive may be treated accordingly under examination practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendment procedures (§714) — signature requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Signature requirements for amendments to an application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendment procedures (§714) — fees for added claims
rubrics_metrics.description: Adding claims in excess of previously paid-for counts triggers additional fees.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendments after allowance (37 CFR 1.312)
rubrics_metrics.description: Special procedures and limits governing amendments filed after allowance under 37 CFR 1.312.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendments filed after reply period expiration
rubrics_metrics.description: Treatment and entry options for amendments submitted after the reply period has expired.

rubrics_metrics.name: Entry procedures and partial entry scenarios
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for entry of amendments and how partial entry of amendments is handled.

rubrics_metrics.name: Period for reply (§710)
rubrics_metrics.description: Statutory and shortened periods for reply to office actions, and available extensions of time.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application abandonment (§711)
rubrics_metrics.description: Types of abandonment (express, constructive) and procedures for revival of abandoned applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interview procedures and restrictions (§713)
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules governing interviews between applicants/representatives and examiners, including permissible subjects and limitations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Affidavits and declarations to overcome rejections (§715–718)
rubrics_metrics.description: Use of affidavits and declarations as evidentiary tools to overcome rejections during prosecution.

rubrics_metrics.name: File wrapper maintenance (§719)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements and practices for maintaining the prosecution history/file wrapper during and after examination.
